In baseball, the batting average is often used to measure the value of a player. With more than a century of data from different eras, the Mendoza line  -- the only exception os the pitcher. No matter how valuable the player may be as a fielder, if he cannot consistently hit the ball, he won't remain in major league baseball. Named after Mario Mendoza who play in the majors for nine years. 

So, is there a line for NFL quarterbacks that if they fall below, they are not a starter? What stat to use? What stats are relevant?
